text: ロケットだんに　しのび　こむ　とは　なんて　やつ

structure.jp: ロケットだんに　しのび　こむ　とは
structure.en: to think you'd sneak into Team Rocket

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.span: しのび　こむ　とは
patterns.explanation: とは after a verb shows shock at what was done, like 'to think that...'. しのび　こむ　とは = 'to think you'd sneak in'.

patterns.name: なんて〜
patterns.explanation: なんて before a word makes an outcry like 'what a...!'. なんて　やつ = 'what a guy!'.
